UPDATE usermember
id = #{id},
pw = #{pw},
name = #{name},
email = #{email},
carNum = #{carNum},
carTypes = #{carTypes}
WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: SELECT carNum, parkingFloor, entryTime FROM parking_records WHERE carNum = #{carNum} AND exitTime IS NULL ORDER BY entryTime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS id, u.carNum AS carNum, u.carTypes AS carTypes, -- 1. 차량 번호 존재 여부 CASE WHEN u.carNum IS NOT NULL AND u.carNum != '' THEN true ELSE false END AS hasCar, -- 2. 오늘 날짜가 정기권 기간 내(startDate ~ endDate)에 들어오는지 체크 CASE WHEN p.regId IS NOT NULL AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN p.startDate AND p.endDate THEN true ELSE false END AS isPrepaid, p.startDate AS startDate, p.endDate AS endDate FROM usermember u LEFT JOIN prepaid p ON u.carNum = p.carNum AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN p.startDate AND p.endDate WHERE u.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
